test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

She has / bought / a car / two years ago.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence uses the present perfect tense** 'She has bought',** which is incorrect when referring to a specific time in the past like **'two years ago'**.
 
• The present perfect tense is used to describe actions that have occurred at an unspecified time before now, whereas 'two years ago' specifies a definite time in the **past.**
 
• Therefore, the correct form should be the simple past tense** 'She bought' instead of 'She has bought'.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: ***She bought a car two years ago*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The simple past tense is used for actions that were completed at a specific point in the **past.**
 
• Examples:
 
 
• *She finished her homework an hour ago.*
 
• *They moved to a new house last month.*
